title: Rest in Peace Rick Hogaboam
author: Brian Almon
summary: The article reflects on the sudden passing of Nampa Mayor Rick Hogaboam, who collapsed during a meeting and was unable to be revived despite immediate CPR efforts. His death is a significant loss for Nampa and Idaho, as he was seen as a promising leader with a strong understanding of local governance and a commitment to his faith. The author emphasizes the importance of valuing life and maintaining priorities, highlighting Hogaboam's example of integrating faith with public service.
